name: std::moneypunct<CharT,International>::thousands_sep, do_thousands_sep
intro:
1) Public member function, calls the member function do_thousands_sep of the most derived class.

2) Returns the character to be used as the separator between digit groups when parsing or formatting the integral parts of monetary values.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: The object of type char_type to use as the thousands separator. In common U.S. locales, this is ',' or L','.

examples.output:
american locale: $123,456.78
locale with modified moneypunct: 12 34 56 78

summary: 1) Public member function, calls the member function do_thousands_sep of the most derived class.
